Speaker: Book
Text: To my little owl,\n\nYour last letter caught up with me in Morthal. I have been counting other people's troubles again. You would say I ought to finish my own work before taking on theirs.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Neuer V2-Brief zum bereits vorgesehenen Daughter-Beat; kein Ersatz eines aktiven Buchs.

Speaker: Book
Text:
I still hope to be home before Frostfall. Hope is an awkward word to send a child, but I would rather write it than promise another day I cannot keep.

Keep a page for me in your stories. I will bring mine.

Father
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Privater Brief ohne Oculatus-Enthüllung; in der Zimmervariante vor Hrefnas Zögern sichtbar.

Speaker: Book
Text: To the one who came,\n\nI am still in Hjaalmarch. There is work if you do not ask too much about the roof over it. I have been mending nets. The hands remember that work too.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur outcome=released; sieben Spieltage später. Keine vollständige Wiederherstellung des gepfändeten Hofs.

Speaker: Book
Text:
I will not write down what happened. You know. I know. I wanted to tell you I have lit no more candles in the cellar. There are things I must decide without waiting for someone at the door.

Thank you for letting me leave.

Hrefna
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Freilassung ist kein versteckter Vertrag; keine Tochter Svala hinzuerfinden.
